messages.content:
[1] כרב (Aramaic) = "like Rav" — in: או כרבי יוחנן דאי [כרב] מאי אריא נתקל אפילו
  rejected: רַב
  1. *כְּרַב I — cmp. כָּרָה), Af. אַכְרֵב to surround, crown
  2. כָּבַן — cmp. כָּבַל) to clasp, fasten. Part. pass. כָּבוּן, f. כְּבוּנָה, pl. כְּבוּנוֹת clasped, esp. sheep wearing a; Pi. to clasp a wrap; to wrap up
  3. כְּבַן — Pa. כַּבֵּין to fasten; to put on a כְּבֵינְתָּא
  4. כְּרַב II — preced.) [to dig around, denom. כְּרוֹבָא, fr. which כְּרַב] to plough
  5. רַב I — large, great; much
  6. רַב II — preced.); superior, master; teacher

[2] כהנא (Aramaic) = "Kahana" — in: רב [כהנא] אמר מהכא אם טרף
  rejected: כֹּהֵן
  1. הֲנָא — v. הֲנִי
  2. הַנֵּי — v. הָן
  3. הני — denom. of הֲנָאָה), Nif. נֶהֱנֶה (= נֵאוֹת, v. אוֹת I); to be pleased, to enjoy, to profit; to be enjoyed; Pi. to benefit, to entertain, to cause to share
  4. הֲנִי — preced.) to please, to profit; Af. to please, do good, benefit; Af. to take effect, be legal; Ithpa. to profit, enjoy, be gratified
  5. נָא I — = אֲנָא
  6. נָא II — also adverb)(b. h; hurried, half-done; slender, fine, brittle. — Pl. נָאִין; f. נָאוֹת
  7. נָא III — b. h.) I pray, prithee. Yoma IV
  8. בַּקָּשָׁה — preced.) desire, prayer
  9. נַן — pl. of נָא I
  10. כָּהַן — b. h.), Nithpa. נִתְכַּהֵן (denom. of כֹּהֵן) to be appointed priest, to act as priest
  11. כָּהֵן — (Aramaic, ch.) same as the entry above: b. h.), Nithpa. נִתְכַּהֵן (denom. of כֹּהֵן) to be appointed priest, to act as priest

[3] מייהו (Aramaic) = "their juice" — in: מייתי ליה גרוגרות מייץ [מייהו] ושדי להו
  rejected: מַיִם
  1. מָהוּ — = מה הו) what is it? how is it?
  2. מִי I — מִי־, מֵי־ from, of; because, v. מִ־
  3. מ — Mem, the thirteenth letter of the Alphabet. It interchanges with נ, esp. in the plural termination ִים, (Chald
  4. מִ־ — followed by Dagesh forte), מֵ־, מֵי־ (before gutturals) prefix for מִן; from, of, e. g. מִמָּקוֹם from a place; מֵאֵמָתַי from what time &c.—מֵאֵל־, v. אֶל; v. מִדּ־) from the time that, when; from the fact that, since; also separated מִי, e. g
  5. מִי II — b. h.); who?; which?; he who; who will?,] Oh that!; is there any?; in gen. introducing a question:] is there?, does he? &c
  6. מַי — what?; v. מַאי
  7. מַאי — = מא הי) what?; why?
  8. מַי ² — water, v. מַיִם
  9. מַיָּא — pl. water, v. מַיִּין
  10. מַיִין — water

[4] והוא (Aramaic) = "and this (applies)" — in: בר מרתא משמיה דרב [והוא] דכתיב רוביה דספרא שפיר
  rejected: הוּא ²
  1. הוּא — b. h.) he, it; she; it is &c
  2. הֲוָא — v. הוי
  3. הֲוֵי — fut. יֶהֱוֵי, יְהֵא, יְהֵי ch; same; to dwell upon, discuss, v. infra; Pa. הַוֵּא; Pa. to produce; Pa. also Peel) with ב or על to dwell upon, to discuss, argue, oppose, cmp. קים
  4. הוֹי — b. h.) woe!, ah!
  5. הוי — b. h.) to exist; to be, become; to occur, come to pass.—With part. ה׳ מביט he looked; ה׳ אומר he said, freq. u; frequent, usual; existing, enduring; Pi. v. הְוָיָה; Pi. to change one’s legal status, to dispose of; Pi. to produce, make
  6. הָא I — demonstr. pronoun) this. Yoma
  7. הָא II — v. preced.) an interjection; cmp. הָ־) Oh!; behold(h; introducing a question, is it that?
  8. הֵא II — He-He
  9. הִא III — name of a worm, v. הֵה
  10. הָהּ — interj.) ah, alas!
  11. הֵה — heh, name of a worm in the pomegranate
